name: Vertex Array Object Voxel Rendering
aliases: Vertex Array Objects (VAOs) with per-vertex color
definition: A rendering technique using Vertex Array Objects and Vertex Buffer Objects to store interleaved position and color data per vertex for voxel quads.
summary: Vertex Array Object Voxel Rendering converts voxel data into explicit GPU-stored quads using interleaved buffers, prioritizing implementation simplicity over the low video memory usage of geometry shaders.
